title: 第25章 彻查第26章 五公主是不是有病
lines: 太子点头，心里大概明白了父皇的意思。
这个蓝星，的确是个可用之才。
太子思索了一番，将腰间的一把匕首取下来，然后递给宁宸，道：
“蓝公子，我出来的急，身无他物，这把匕首送给你，当做见面礼，还请不要嫌弃。”
宁宸微微一怔，看着对方手里的匕首。
这把匕首造型精美，上面以红宝石点缀，造型精美，一看就价值不菲。
这怎么好意思啊？不能直接要，得客气客气。
他连忙摇头，“这可不行，这东西太贵重了，我不能要。”
太子笑道：“蓝公子，我是真心想交你这个朋友...还请别推辞。”
宁宸有些为难，人家都这样说了，不收好像不合适。
这是玄帝开口：“蓝星，小玩意儿而已，拿着吧！以后你们年轻人之间多走动。”
“既然如此，那我就恭敬不如从命了...多谢大叔，多谢玄公子。”
宁宸接过匕首，再次道谢。
玄帝起身，道：“出来时间不短了，该回去了...蓝星，刚才你润色的那首诗很不错，算你两百两银子。”
宁宸两眼放光。
“大叔，只是润色，你给的太多了吧？”
玄帝笑着说道：“不多，银子我继续给你存着，需要的时候找我拿。”
“谢谢大叔！”
“行了，今日时间不早了，我们该回去了...蓝星，你照旧吃完饭再回去。”
宁宸连连道谢，怪不好意思的，连吃带拿。
回皇宫的马车上。
玄帝看向太子，“你觉得这个蓝星如何？”
太子恭敬作答：“蓝星的确才华过人，机智又有谋略，是个不可多得的人才。”
“但是，才华不代表人品，这点儿臣还得慢慢观察观察再说。”
玄帝满意的点点头。
“那你们以后就多接触接触。”
“儿臣遵命！”
九公子美目一翻，哼了一声。
玄帝轻笑，“怀安对宁宸有意见？”
“父皇，你没听他怎么说的吗？说什么傻子才娶公主，这是藐视皇威...我看他人品不怎么样，胆子倒是挺大。”
玄帝笑了起来，“他不知道我们的身份，说话不中听，也可以理解。”
“哼，反正我不喜欢他。”
九公主皱着鼻子，一脸不开心。
宁宸不知道，他的一番吐槽，彻底得罪了九公主。
“其实他的真名不叫蓝星，他叫宁宸，是礼部尚书宁自明的四儿子。”
content_en:
The prince nodded, probably understanding what his father meant.
This Blue Star is indeed a useful talent.
The prince thought for a while, took off a dagger from his waist, handed it to Ning Chen, and said:
"Mr. Lan, I came out in a hurry and have nothing else. I give this dagger to you as a greeting gift. Please don't dislike it."
Ning Chen was slightly startled and looked at the dagger in the opponent's hand.
This dagger is beautifully shaped and embellished with rubies. It has a beautiful shape and is worth a lot of money at a glance.
Why is this so embarrassing? You can't ask for it directly, you have to be polite.
He shook his head quickly, "That's not possible. This thing is too valuable. I can't have it."
The prince smiled and said: "Master Lan, I really want to make you a friend... please don't refuse."
Ning Chen was a little embarrassed. Everyone had said this, so it seemed inappropriate not to accept it.
This is when Emperor Xuan said: "Blue Star, it's just a gadget, take it! You young people will move around more in the future."
"In this case, I would rather obey your orders than be respectful... Many thanks, uncle, and many thanks, Mr. Xuan."
Ning Chen took the dagger and thanked him again.
Emperor Xuan stood up and said, "It's been a long time since I've been out. It's time to go back... Lanxing, the poem you polished just now is very good. I'll give you two hundred taels of silver."
Ning Chen's eyes lit up.
"Uncle, it's just polishing. Did you give me too much?"
Emperor Xuan smiled and said: "It's not much. I will continue to save the money for you. Ask me to get it when you need it."
"Thank you, uncle!"
"Okay, it's getting late today, we should go back... Lanxing, you should finish your meal before going back."
Ning Chen thanked him profusely, feeling embarrassed that he even ate and took it.
On the carriage back to the palace.
Emperor Xuan looked at the prince, "What do you think of this Blue Star?"
The prince replied respectfully: "Blue Star is indeed extremely talented, witty and strategic. He is a rare talent."
"However, talent does not represent character. I have to observe and observe this point slowly."
Emperor Xuan nodded with satisfaction.
"Then you guys will have more contact with each other in the future."
"My son, I obey!"
Ninth Young Master rolled his beautiful eyes and snorted.
Emperor Xuan chuckled, "Huai'an has a problem with Ning Chen?"
"Father, didn't you listen to what he said? He said that only a fool would marry a princess. This is contempt of the emperor's power... I don't think his character is very good, but he is quite courageous."
Emperor Xuan laughed, "It's understandable that he doesn't know our identities and his words are unpleasant."
"Huh, I don't like him anyway."
The Ninth Princess wrinkled her nose and looked unhappy.
Ning Chen didn't know that his complaints had completely offended the Ninth Princess.
"Actually, his real name is not Lan Xing. His name is Ning Chen. He is the fourth son of Ning Ziming, the Minister of Rites."
title_en: Chapter 25 Thorough Investigation Chapter 26 Is the Fifth Princess Sick?
